intro.title: REPOPULATE THE OCEAN, FEED THE FUTURE
intro.caption: Shedding light on the systemic impact of intensive aquaculture, and more specifically on salmon consumption.
intro.imageAlt: School of fish surfing a wave

ambition.origin: PinkBombs was born from a simple ambition: to shed light on the systemic impact of intensive aquaculture, and more specifically on salmon consumption.
ambition.paragraph: Supported by Seastemik in collaboration with DataForGood, PinkBombs offers a transparent and documented vision of the ecological, health, and ethical issues related to fish production and consumption. More than an alert platform, it is a real decision-making tool designed for citizens, companies, and public decision-makers. Our mission is clear: to support the transition towards an Ocean-friendly diet. Because "un-fishing" our plates means repopulating the Ocean and feeding the future.

situation.title: Situation
situation.paragraph: We are facing an ocean emergency. The Ocean, the main source of life on Earth, is increasingly threatened by human activities. Fish consumption is the main cause of marine biodiversity loss. The salmon industry, emblematic of intensive aquaculture, generates multiple impacts on a global scale. It is therefore urgent to change the food system for better protection of humans, animals, and ecosystems.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.imageAlt: Happy fish looking at the future
reaction.paragraph:
PinkBombs is here to:
  • Alert on one of the greatest threats to the Ocean today: salmon farming.
  • Deconstruct the popular perception around salmon consumption.
  • Guide companies, governments, and consumers towards positive solutions.

seastemik.title: Seastemik
seastemik.paragraph: Seastemik (a pun between the sea and systemic) is an NGO founded in 2023 that provides a systemic response to Ocean protection, by integrating environmental, economic, social, ethical, and health issues. Our vision: An Ocean overflowing with life, preserved by a plant-based diet, which guarantees the habitability of our planet, climate stability, human health, food justice, and animal welfare. The problem is systemic, the response must be too. Our mission: Un-fish our diets to repopulate the Ocean. Guide the phase-out of intensive fish farming (intensive aquaculture), spearheaded by salmon, and the development of a plant-based diet that makes the taste buds dance without emptying the Ocean. To move from ocean dining... to restoring the Ocean.

dataforgood.title: DataForGood
dataforgood.paragraph:
Data For Good is a non-profit organization created in 2014 that brings together a community of 7,000+ tech volunteers (Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Developers, UX/UI Designers, Product & Project Owners) wishing to commit to the general interest.

Every year, we work with around fifteen associations to co-build projects that work for social justice, democracy, and the environment. We have supported, accelerated, and co-built more than 100 projects over the last 10 years.

We are also strong critics of the risks and abuses of technology. Being part of the community also means committing to sober technology that respects social and environmental issues, and accepting that technology is not the solution to all problems.

partner.title: Partner
partner.paragraph:
This project was carried out with the support of KRESK 4 OCEANS.

KRESK 4 OCEANS is an endowment fund created by the KRESK Group and its brands (SVR and Lazartigue) whose objective is to create projects and fund non-profit organizations that aim to actively fight against marine pollution.

story.title: Story
story.paragraphFirstPart: In 2024, we launched the first version of Pinkbombs, which had major media coverage and advanced the cause. Our data was exclusively used by the newspaper Le Monde to publish an article by Les Décodeurs on the impact of salmon farming.
story.paragraphLastPart: Since then, the data has been relayed by numerous media outlets such as Bon Pote, Brut, France Inter, BFM, or the TF1 1pm news, thus raising collective awareness about the impacts of the salmon industry.

method.title: Approach and methodology
method.caption: PinkBombs was created to analyze and transform public data into tools accessible to everyone.

values.title: Our approach is based on two values:
items: Open source: The data is available on the platform.
Collaborative: Contact us to contribute or suggest improvements.

steps.title: Our process followed three steps:
items: Identification of priority topics: As the goal of the site is to offer a compilation of the most striking information on the subject, the organization started by prioritizing the topics to be addressed.
In-depth research: Desk research was conducted online and by contacting experts, taking care to use only scientific sources or those from renowned international organizations.
Peer-reviewed data: In the interest of data quality, all information was verified internally. Expert support provided the final validation.

method.missingInfo: Did we miss key information? Do you have a question? Please contact us.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.paragraph: Seastemik dreams of an Ocean overflowing with life, preserved by a plant-based diet, which guarantees the habitability of our planet. Do you have a question, an idea, a project to imagine, or a growing desire to act with us? Write to us. Whether you are a citizen, professional, researcher, journalist, association, or simply curious, there are a thousand ways to advance the iodine revolution.
